title: ChunksetDriftReport v1.0
description: Sidecar artifact emitted by lib.validators.chunkset_drift.ChunksetDriftValidator at <LibV2 course root>/drift_report.json. Records drift between the DART evidence chunkset (dart_chunks/chunks.jsonl) and the IMSCC packaged chunkset (imscc_chunks/chunks.jsonl): which DART block ids were never cited (DART_EVIDENCE_DROPPED) and which IMSCC chunks have no traceable origin (IMSCC_CLAIM_NOT_IN_DART). Wave 3 W3.D — schema 1.0.
